newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Central Puerto to build $140 mln plant.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Central Puerto to build $140 mln plant.

text.p: Argentine utility Central Puerto said Wednesday it signed a contract for local group Techint and U.S. General Electric Power Systems to build it a $140 million 382 MW combined cycle plant.
Construction will take two years and the plant will be operative by the end of 1998, it added in a press release.
With the new plant Central Puerto, Argentina's biggest thermoelectric generator, will increase its installed capacity to 1,761 MW from 1,370.

Central Puerto, controlled by Chilean utilities Chilgener and Chilquinta, said the civil works will be done by Techint Compania Tecnica Internacional while the generating plant will be provided by Gnereral Electric Power Systems.
